sources.entry: Receipt Wrangler ⚠ - Easy-to-use receipt manager, powered by AI. Allows users to create receipts effortlessly and quickly, categorize and more. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Receipt Wrangler is a receipt manager, described as AI-powered, for creating and categorizing receipts, with an API, desktop app and mobile app in one monorepo.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that the repository contains the Receipt Wrangler API, a desktop app, and a mobile app. It says these were previously separate repositories and are now merged into one monolith. Each application lives in its own directory, and the README points to those directories for details. The README itself does not describe features, setup steps, or the AI functionality. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as an easy-to-use receipt manager that lets users create receipts and categorize them.
use_cases: manage receipts from a desktop app
manage receipts from a mobile app
notable: Single monorepo combining API, desktop and mobile apps
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Money, Budgeting & Management
caveats: README is minimal and gives no setup or run instructions; see the subdirectories
awesome-selfhosted listing carries a warning marker, whose meaning is not explained in the README
AI features are named only in the listing, not in the README
